synthesizedFacts.fact: Primary teeth, also known as baby teeth, typically begin to erupt around 6 months of age and continue until about 3 years old.
Children usually start losing their primary teeth at around 6 years of age, beginning with the central incisors.
By age 21, all 32 permanent teeth have usually erupted.
